segments.sn9.14:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe.
segments.sn9.14:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā padumaṃ upasiṅghati.
segments.sn9.14:1.3: Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetukāmā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn9.14:9.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu tāya devatāya saṃvejito saṃvegamāpādīti.

lines: Cuddasame ajjhabhāsīti taṃ bhikkhuṃ nāḷe gahetvā padumaṃ siṅghamānaṃ disvāva –

“ayaṃ bhikkhu satthu santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā samaṇadhammaṃ kātuṃ araññaṃ paviṭṭho gandhārammaṇaṃ upanijjhāyati, svāyaṃ ajja upasiṅghaṃ svepi punadivasepi upasiṅghissati, evamassa sā gandhataṇhā vaḍḍhitvā diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikaṃ atthaṃ nāsessati, mā mayi passantiyā nassatu, codessāmi nan”ti upasaṅkamitvā abhāsi.
Ekaṅgametaṃ theyyānanti thenitabbānaṃ rūpārammaṇādīnaṃ pañcakoṭṭhāsānaṃ idaṃ ekaṅgaṃ, ekakoṭṭhāsoti attho.
Ārāti dūre nāḷe gahetvā nāmetvā dūre ṭhito upasiṅghāmīti vadati.
Tasmiṃ kira devatāya saddhiṃ kathenteyeva eko tāpaso otaritvā bhisakhananādīni kātuṃ āraddho, taṃ sandhāyevamāha.
Na vuccatīti gandhacoroti vā pupphacoroti vā kasmā na vuccati.
Ākiṇṇaluddoti bahupāpo gāḷhapāpo vā, tasmā na vuccati.
Dhāticelaṃva makkhitoti yathā dhātiyā nivatthakiliṭṭhavatthaṃ uccārapassāvapaṃsumasikaddamādīhi makkhitaṃ, evamevaṃ rāgadosādīhi makkhito.
Devatāya codanā kira sugatānusiṭṭhisadisā, na taṃ lāmakā hīnādhimuttikā micchāpaṭipannakapuggalā labhanti.
Tasmiṃ pana attabhāve maggaphalānaṃ bhabbarūpā puggalā taṃ labhanti, tasmā evamāha.
“ayaṃ bhikkhu atthi me hitakāmā devatā, sā maṃ codessati sāressatīti pamādampi anuyuñjeyya, nāssa vacanaṃ sampaṭicchissāmī”ti.
Yenāti yena kammena sugatiṃ gaccheyyāsi, taṃ kammaṃ tvaṃyeva jāneyyāsīti.
Ekaṅgametaṃ theyyānanti ārammaṇavasena theyyavatthūsu vibhajiyamānesu ekamaṅgametaṃ gandhārammaṇanti āha “thenitabbānan”tiādi.
Ojāpekkhāya theyyāya pavattamānāya dhammārammaṇatāpi tassā siyā, sā pana na madhurā theyyakatā cāti “pañcakoṭṭhāsānan”ti vuttaṃ.
Kāmañca taṃ gandhārammaṇaṃ kenaci pariggahitaṃ na hotīti ādiyituṃ sakkā, satthārā pana ananuññātattā na yutto tassa paribhogo.
Yaṃ pana tena bhikkhunā vuttaṃ “na harāmi na bhañjāmī”ti, tassapi ayameva parihāro.
Vaṇṇīyati phalaṃ etenāti vaṇṇaṃ, kāraṇanti vuttaṃ “vaṇṇenāti kāraṇenā”ti.
Ākiṇṇakammantoti taṇhādiṭṭhiādivasena akusalakammanto diṭṭhimohataṇhādivasena ādito paṭṭhāya kusalakammānaṃ paṭikkhepanato.

Gandhārammaṇaṃ upanijjhāyatīti gandhasaṅkhātaṃ ārammaṇaṃ upecca nijjhāyati, rūpārammaṇena viya viññāṇena rūpaṃ, gandhārammaṇena taṃ upecca nijjhāyati paccakkhato, yāthāvato sabhāvato paṭivijjhatīti attho.
